svg.title: DPP5.0 definition: access-controlled verifiable evidence graphs
svg.desc: The seven proposed DPP5.0 properties: evidence graphs, verifiable issuer claims, access control, open standards, open-world semantics, accountability and cross-company sharing. Based on page 27 of the original 36-page visual paper; adapted by removing slide numbering and footer while preserving explanatory diagrams.
